content: This program uses a photo detector over I²C. The driver already handles register reads and writes, and it has functions for turning the LED on and off. What I need are unit tests that confirm all the critical parts of the system behave correctly.

Let me capture the core objective: build a robust test suite for the I²C photo detector driver, covering register access, LED control, and error handling. I can outline the testing goals and ask which harness/framework we should target. Does that align with what you want?

Yes. Use the existing UART-based hardware harness for on-target tests, and keep Unity/CMock for host-side driver unit tests. Integrate both with GitHub Actions so we flash the board via OpenOCD/pyOCD and capture UART logs and JUnit XML.
Great. I’ll reflect those requirements in the PRD: objectives around on-target plus host tests, CI pipeline details, and explicit acceptance criteria. I’ll update the document now.
